profile.headline: Software Engineer II | Chewy
profile.summary:
Passionate software engineer with 4+ years of industry experience specializing in the frontend. 

Skilled in developing innovative and reliable solutions to complex problems. 

Proficient in React, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Java, REST API and MySQL among other technologies with a strong foundation in software engineering principles and best practices. 

Committed to delivering high-quality code and exceptional user experiences.

positions.title: Software Engineer - SiteVault
positions.description:
- Built full-stack features using React, TypeScript, Java, Python, and MySQL for an industry-leading Life Sciences SaaS product, delivering high-impact functionality used by >12,000 enterprise monthly active users
- Led development of mission-critical REST APIs, reducing SonarQube cognitive complexity by 40% in a key code package and significantly improving long-term maintainability and scalability of a core product area
- Re-architected a major 35-component React/TypeScript UI, cutting TTI from ~5s → <1s and driving significant improvements in customer-centric UX, page load/re-render performance, and system reliability
- Elevated engineering quality by upholding SonarQube A-grade maintainability, and sustaining >80% unit test coverage on all new code authored
- Accelerated team delivery velocity by shipping 20+ reusable UI components, 100+ shared backend service/repo methods, 10+ public REST APIs, and several internal tools adopted across the org, reducing duplicated work and improving cross-team development consistency
- Collaborated with Product and QA to ship high-impact features through rigorous design reviews, UX feedback sessions, unit/integration testing, and proactive release testing during release cycles

positions.title: Master of Science in Computer Science
Software Development Co-op
positions.description:
● Developed, built, and tested web applications for Health Science Global Business Unit UX/User Management teams
● Used JavaScript, Java, OJET, HTML/CSS, Git, SVN to develop new UI/UX-focused applications and enhancements

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
● Engaged member of 7 person development team with goal of creating dynamic, interactive website for Northeastern University's WRBB Radio Station
● Utilizes PHP, HTML, JavaScript, CSS, SASS, Wordpress, jQuery, Bootstrap, MAMP/MAMP Pro, Git to develop features
● Translates prototype designs into styled, functional components of website
● Identifies and addresses bug fixes and enhancement requests

positions.title: Lead Nurse
positions.description:
● Oversaw the planning, organizing and execution of flu vaccination clinics in the Boston Area 
● Facilitated communications between clinic sites, flu nurses and main corporate site 
● Promoted patient education with most up-to-date CDC guidelines and recommendations

positions.title: Neurology / Oncology Nurse
positions.description:
● Engaged member of healthcare team on a 32-bed neuroscience / oncology inpatient care unit 
● Cared for diverse patient population, including stroke, epilepsy, autoimmune, neurosurgery, neuro 
● Proficient user of Epic software & documentation systems 
● Contributed to unit’s receipt of Massachusetts General Hospital’s Patient Experience Award for 2018

honors.title: Johnson & Johnson Future for Nursing Award
Patient Advocacy Award
honors.issuer: Issued by Northeastern University School of Nursing
